title: An arena with markers
hints: Get the block with `::operator new(capacity, std::align_val_t{ 64 })` and free it with the matching `::operator delete(ptr, std::align_val_t{ 64 })` in the destructor. Because the start is 64-aligned, an offset that is a multiple of `align` gives an address that is too.
Check that the request fits before moving the offset, and compare as `bytes > size - start` (after checking `start <= size`) so the arithmetic cannot overflow.

`make` is a template that takes any number of constructor arguments (`Args&&... args` is a "parameter pack"). Pass them all on to the constructor with placement new, keeping each one as it was given: `return new (place) T(std::forward<Args>(args)...);` (`std::forward` is in `<utility>`). Allocate `place` with `allocate(sizeof(T), alignof(T))` first and return `nullptr` if that failed.
